items.hyp: Abakungu b'omu South Africa baali beeyongera okwewala mu kunoonyereza.

items.hyp: Ekigenda, ku lunaku lwe yali asooka, omumyuka wa pulezidenti wa South Africa yali atuuse ku hospital owa Kayumba yali agambye.

items.hyp: Yali yadduka eyali omukulu wa South Africa eyali ekiyitibwa spy, Bill Masetera, n'omuwi w'omuwi w'ennyumba ey'omu Patrick Karegyeya era n'omuwanvu wa Kayumba.
items.ref: Yeegattibwako eyali akulira bambega e South Africa, Bill Masetera mukwano ennyo gwa Patrick Karegyeya bwe bali ennyo ku mbiranye ne Kayumba.

items.hyp: Masetera yali akulira ekitongole ekikessi ekya South Africa era Karegyeya yali akulira dayirekita wa wansi w'eggwanga.
items.ref: Masetera ye yali akulira ekitongole ekikessi mu South Africa Karegyeya gye yali akulira ebyokwerinda wabweru wa South Africa.

items.hyp: Masetera yali alina okuba n'omukwanaganya w'ekibiina ky'abakyala ekyali pulezidenti wa South Africa, Thabo Mbeki.
items.ref: Masetera oluvannyuma yafuuka omuwabuzi ku byokwerinda ow'eyaliko pulezidenti wa South Africa, Thabo Mbeki.

items.hyp: Aba Masetera baatandika okulwanyisa nti Masetera yali asobola okukola ekintu kye kikulu e Mbeki era nga ye pulezidenti wa Uganda.
items.ref: Ababiri baalemagana oluvannyuma lw'ebigambibwa nti Masetera nti yali ayongedde amaanyi mu mulabe wa Mbeki asingayo era Pulezidenti aliko, Jacob Zuma.

items.hyp: Masetera yagamba nti pulezidenti bazze okukozesa era bwe yali ayagala, abakungu baabwe baali bagenda okukozesa.
items.ref: Enkolagana ya Masetera ne Karegyeya yeeyongera nga bw'agamba kati, nti bapulezidenti batera okukozesa abakulira obukessi ate bwe bamala ne babasuulawo.

items.ref: Nali ssajenti mu kibinja ky'abayeekera eky'ekkumi n'omwenda ekya National Riffle Association leero ekiyitibwa Uganda People's Defence Force.

items.hyp: Mu 1990 twatandika ne Gulu.
items.ref: Mu lukumi mu lwenda kyenda twadda ffenna e Gulu.

items.hyp: Nga Okitobba 1, 1990, twaliweebwa mu makya amalala e Kagitumba awatali kya kibiina kya Rehabilitation Project Force e Kati.

items.hyp: Okufuna obulamu bw'amatwala mu kiseera kino, kwe kityo kwe kuba nga kikola kya maanyi nnyo era n'obuyinza obw'amaanyi n'obw'ekikulu.
items.ref: Okufuna ekitono mu bya ffirimu, okugeza, olw'okubaawo ebintu ebirala ebirungi ebiyinza okweyambisibwa nga Kodak ne Fuji.

items.hyp: Oluvannyuma lw'okukola ebyo eby'obufuzi ebiri mu Mozambique, mu Lwaddaniya, mu Morafirika, ne mu Esitibuli, kino kino kye kikolebwa mu Uganda.
items.ref: Oluvannyuma lw'okukozesebwa obulungi mu pulojekiti ezaatambula obulungi Mozambique, Lebanon, Morocco ne Ethiopia, ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu kimaze ne kituuka mu Uganda.

items.hyp: Ekitongole kya CinemArena mu Uganda kikola ennyo mu kutunda ebintu ebitali bimu, olw'okuba n'ekitongole kya Italy ekikola n'ekya Amakula Film.
items.ref: Ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu mu Uganda kyetooloolera ku kukyusa mbeera z'abantu, okusiima kugende eri Italian cooperation ne Amakula Film.

items.hyp: Bannange abo bali mu Gulu era nga kino kijja kuba nga tewali ngeri gye bimaze okutuuka nga gye bimaze okutuuka ku bifo ebimu.
items.ref: Musanyufu nnyo n'abantu b'e Gulu pulojekiti gy'eddukanyizibwa nti tebakoma bukomi ku kutambula ngendo mpanvu okugenda mu bifo bye baagala.

items.hyp: Abantu abo mu Gulu beeyambiza okutuuka ku ngeri y'emu okutuuka ku makya g'ekitundu.
items.ref: Abantu b'e Gulu bavumu mu obunnyogovu bw'ekiro okutuukira ddala mu matumbi budde.

items.hyp: Ekitongole ekirwanyisa kino ekikola ku nsonga z'omu byalo eby'okwerinda ekwata ku nsi yonna ekwata ku kifo ky'okukola ebyo ebyali mu Itali.
items.ref: Ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu kivujjirirwa ekitebe kya Italy Development Cooperation office.

items.hyp: Entugga entegekeddwa entegekeddwa mu bitundu bya Uganda n'ebitundu ebirala.
items.ref: Emmotoka y'abasuubuzi etambula yeetooloola ekibuga n'ebitundu by'ekyalo mu Uganda.

items.ref: Abazinyi abazina amazina Amacholi basanyusa abantu ku nnaku ez'okukola bongera okunyumisa ekintu.

items.hyp: Abaaliwo olw'okuba n'ekitongole kyaffe gamba nti ekyo kyali kikulu n'ekya Barak Obama "Yes We Can" eyalagira okwewala mu ofiisi.

items.hyp: Marco Ballerini, omukulu w'akatale yagamba nti okusinziira ku kunoonyereza ajja kuleetawo abantu okukola engeri gye jja kuleetawo okukola mu maaso.
items.ref: Marco Ballerini, akulira pulojekiti yagambye nti mu kukola ekyo abantu abalina obukugu bajja kukulemberamu enkulaakulana y'omu maaso.

items.hyp: Ekitundu ekisinga okutuuka mu bitundu bina emyaka 22 mu disitulikiti y'e Gulu kyakakasibwa nga Jjuuni 25 ne kijja kwe kufaananako Jjulaayi 25.
items.ref: Pulojekiti egenda okukolebwa mu magombolola agasukka amakumi abiri mu disitulikiti y'e Gulu yatandika nga abiri mu ttaano Ogwomukaaga era ya kukomekkerezebwa ng'abiri mu ttaano Ogwomusanvu.

items.ref: Baanokolayo nti abamu ku bannaabwe baayingizibwa eggye lya Uganda People's Deforce Force.

items.hyp: Mu Okitobba 2008 abakulembeze b'ekibiina ky'eby'okwerinda baasalawo okwogera ku ekyo aba ADF abaali bavumirira gavumenti okukyusa abo abali.
items.ref: Mu Gwekkumi gwa 2008, abakulira ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda baasisinkana okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nsonga y'abaliko abayeekera ba ADF balumiriza gavumenti okubakozesa.

items.hyp: Abayeekera ba ADF abaali bakolagana n'abakwatira gavumenti okukolagana n'okutuuka nga tebannasasula ssente.

items.ref: Olw'embeera enzibu era ey'okwennyamira gye bawangaaliramu, bannamawulire ba Allied Democratic Forces abatamanyi kiddako baddiziddwa mu bikolwa by'obutujju.
